mintableHeadroom.description: How much more can be issued right now: attested reserves minus circulating supply (0 if supply already meets or exceeds reserves).

balanceOf.description: Token balance of a holder (includes any held/locked amount).

spendableBalanceOf.description: Balance the holder can transfer right now (total minus held/locked amount).

heldBalanceOf.description: Amount currently locked by holds (e.g. pending redemptions).

isFrozen.description: Whether a holder is frozen (cannot send/receive; force-burn still works).

issue.description: Mint new stablecoin against attested reserves to a compliant recipient. Reverts unless proof-of-reserves covers the new supply. MINTER role.

mint.description: Alias for Issue with an empty reference. Routes through the same proof-of-reserves + compliance gate. MINTER role.

requestRedemption.description: Holder self-service: lock your own tokens pending an off-chain fiat payout. Does not burn.

fulfillRedemption.description: Settle a redemption after the fiat wire: release the hold and burn the tokens. REDEEMER role.

cancelRedemption.description: Release a redemption hold without burning (request rejected or withdrawn). REDEEMER role.

freeze.description: Block a holder from sending/receiving (OFAC / court order). Force-burn still works against frozen holders.

unfreeze.description: Lift a freeze on a holder.

forceBurn.description: Burn tokens from a holder bypassing compliance — the on-chain leg of a seizure/settlement. High risk.

pause.description: Pause all transfers/issuance/redemptions for this stablecoin.

setReserveOracle.description: Swap the proof-of-reserves oracle (e.g. to an auditor multisig or Chainlink PoR feed) without changing mint logic.

setMaxReserveAttestationAge.description: Freshness window (seconds) for reserve attestations before issuance halts. 0 disables the staleness gate.

setMintCap.description: Hard cap on total supply at the base level (reserves still cap issuance). 0 = unlimited at the base level.
